summary: A statistical analysis tool with an integrated frontend back end to analyse motion of selected stellar objects on the SPHEREx mission using most recent data available..
details:
What it does: Users enter a star by name or coordinates; the tool queries NASA's live SPHEREx archive, downloads real matching exposures, splits and cleans the images (alignment, denoising, background subtraction), then statistically detects and ranks objects that moved between observations.

Benefit/impact: SPHEREx generates more data than humans can manually scan, but motion is exactly how Pluto, comets, and brown dwarfs were historically found. We automate search, download, cleaning, and detection end-to-end, making discovery accessible to anyone.

Tools: Python, astropy, astroquery, numpy, scipy, sep, reproject, matplotlib, pandas, Git/GitHub.

Creativity/considerations: Modular pipeline built for parallel teamwork; added retry logic and AWS S3 fallback after hitting real IRSA outages during development; prioritized verifying real data over assumptions.
